This '''clone trooper captain''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he was part of a [[Mission to unidentified besieged moon|mission]] to a [[Unidentified besieged moon|moon]] besieged by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Led by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], he helped evacuating the last of the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] population. The clone trooper captain wore a [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] and was armed with a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]].<ref name="Labyrinth" />
